prompt: Ecto Repo init/2 callback :ignore return restriction
answer:
`Ecto.Repo.init/2` may return `:ignore` **only when called with the `:supervisor` context**.

When called with `:runtime`, it must return:

```elixir
{:ok, updated_config}
```

The callback type is:

```elixir
@callback init(
  :supervisor | :runtime,
  Keyword.t()
) :: {:ok, Keyword.t()} | :ignore
```

The `:ignore` option is therefore restricted to the `:supervisor` case. (Ecto `Ecto.Repo` documentation)
